name: Creamy Garlic Butter King Prawn Jacket Potato
steps: Crispy, cheesy, buttery potato topped with juicy Cajun king prawns and a rich creamy garlic sauce
Cook Book link to my debut cookbook in bio and to this reel.
Potato
Pierce and microwave for 6 mins (less for smaller potatoes). Spray with oil, season with salt, wrap in foil and air fry at 180°C for 55 mins. Unwrap and cook at 200°C for 10 mins until crispy.
Prawns
While the potato cooks, season the prawns and fry until pink. Add garlic butter and baste for 1 min. Remove the prawns, keeping the buttery juices in the pan.
Sauce
Cook the garlic in butter until golden. Add everything except the mozzarella and simmer until slightly thickened. Stir through the mozzarella at the end.
To finish, cut open the potato, add garlic butter, salt, pepper and mozzarella and mash together until melted. Top with the prawns, spoon over the sauce and finish with crispy onions and parsley.

name: Chicken Roll
ingredients: 1 ½ sdm saos tiramlanya udah gue tulis ya
Sweet BBQ Sauce Premium Kecap Sedaap Kedelai Hitam Special
2 ½  sdm Kecap Sedaap Kedelai Hitam Special
1 sdt mustard kuning at aja hasilnya
BBQ Lava Filling campur sama keju spread
4 sdm saus BBQ Kecap Sedaap Kedelai Hitam Special
steps: Chopper ayam sampai halus, seasoning, tambahkan tepung aduk sampai merata di diamkan di kulkas selama satu jam
Campurkan perbumbuan, tumis perbawangan lalu masukan racikan bumbu yang sudah dibuat.

Lalu bentuk ayam tadi menjadi Panjang, baluri dengan tepung roti berikan bolongan di Tengah nya, kemudian goreng hingga matang.
Terakhir masukkan filling lava kedalam ayam. Chicken roll siap dihidangkan.

name: Sop Sengkel
ingredients: Panaskan air, masukkan daging sengkel yang sudah dipotong.
steps: Ganti air dengan air baru, masukkan semua bahan 1 ke dalam presto.
Masak selama 30-40 menit.
Panaskan minyak dalam wajan, goreng bawang merah dan bawang putih secara terpisah.
Angkat dan tiriskan setelah bawang kecokelatan.
Buka presto, masukkan bahan 2 dan wortel.
Masak sebentar hingga wortel matang.
Koreksi rasa, sajikan dengan bahan 3.

name: Slow cooker beef brisket pasta
steps: 1.2 kg beef brisket
½ tsp salt
1 tsp black pepper
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 brown onion, finely chopped
3 garlic cloves, chopped
400g tin diced tomatoes
3 tablespoons tomato paste
½ cup red wine
1 cup beef stock
1 tablespoon dried Italian herbs
350g pasta (any kind you like)
To serve:
Grated Parmesan cheese
Fresh parsley
Method:
Pat the beef brisket dry and season with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Sear the brisket on all sides until well browned.
Transfer the seared brisket to your slow cooker. Add onion, garlic, tinned tomatoes, tomato paste, red wine, beef stock, and dried Italian herbs.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours or high for 4 hours, until the brisket is fall-apart tender.
⁠Remove the brisket, shred it using two forks, then return it to the sauce in the slow cooker. Stir well to combine.
Meanwhile, cook your pasta separately according to packet instructions. Drain and add it to the slow cooker. Stir through the brisket sauce until well coated.
Dish it up with a generous sprinkle of grated Parmesan and fresh parsley. Season to taste.

name: Potato pizza
steps: Rebus kentang kemudian di smash, lalu ditambahkan saus bolognese,sosis dan mozzarella  diatas nya lalu dipanggang selama 15 mennit.

Potong tahu menjadi dua bagian, kemudia masukan adonan tadi kedalam tahu
Kukus tahu sampai matang.

name: Caramelized garlic butter chicken bite
steps: Marinasi ayam dengan bumbu selama 15-30 menit masukan tepung kedalam ayam kemudian goreng sampai matang
Seasoning:
10 siung bawang putih
½ Bombay
1 sdm gula
½ sdm cabe bubuk
1 sdt lada hitam
½ sdt Italian herb
1 sdm kecap inggris
1 sdm kecap asin
1 sdm saus tiram
½ sdt garam

Chopper sampai halus, lalu tumis hingga harum masukkan salted butter, irisan bawang merah, bawang putih dan bawang Bombay, lalu seasoning, masukan ayam aduk hingga merata.

name: Tangsuyuk pancake
steps: Potong paha fillet kecil kecil di marinasi dengan lada, garam dan bawang putih selama 30 menit
Endapkan tepung kentang dengan air, kalau sudah mengendap campur dengan ayam yang sudah di marinasi
Potong panjang daun kucai, mix dengan adonan ayam lalu di goreng di minyak panas.
Untuk membuat saus campurkan bahan bahan ke dalam satu wadah lalu bisa dituangkan kea yam yang sudah jadi.

name: Mini korean corn dog hack~
steps: for this hack, use store bought crescent dough to make the easiest mini korean corn dogs at home.
you'll need:
chunks of mozzarella cheese
mini sausages
crescent dough
2 eggs, beaten
panko breadcrumbs
frying oil
toppings:
samyang buldak sauce
mayo
sugar
optional: make a buldak spicy mayo by mixing together mayo + samyang buldak original hot sauce
directions:
wrap a piece of crescent dough tightly around your mozzarella or sausage + cheese combo, making sure there are no openings so the cheese doesn't leak out while frying.
coat in egg wash, then cover in panko breadcrumbs.
deep fry over medium low heat for a few minutes (about 6-7 mins) until golden brown and crispy. keep the heat lower so the crescent dough has enough time to fully cook while the cheese gets melty ca
finish with buldak sauce, spicy buldak mayo, and a sprinkle of sugar for that classic korean corn dog combo.

name: Creamy chicken lemon
steps: Potong Panjang kentang menjadi 4 bagian baluri minyak dan tuangkan 2-3 sdt dry rub aduk hingga merata
Air fryer 180 derajat selama 25 menit
Marinasi ayam dengan dry rub selama 15-30 menit
Masak di api kecil sampai matang
Lelehkan unsalted butter kedalam pan
Tumis bawang putih dan masukan 1 sdm tepung terigu
Tuangkan susu 250-300ml
Seasoning dengan 1 sdt dry rub, 1 sdt kaldu jamur, ½ sdt lada putih, Sejumput garam, Parsley dan perasan ½ buah lemon
Aduk sampai matang lalu masukan ayam

name: Tahu Kukus

steps: Chopper tahu, udang, telur, daun bawang sampai halus kemudian seasoning dengan bumbu
Tuang adonan ke dalam mangkuk atau wadah kecil lalu dilapisi kulit gyoza diatasnya gunakan methode sandwich atau berulang
